brief:
Galatasaray's president said UEFA informed the Turkish football club of an Israeli complaint regarding pro-Palestinian banners displayed by supporters, Al Jazeera English reported. The club proceeded to defy the complaint rather than comply with pressure to remove the displays.

The incident reflects ongoing tensions over political expression at sporting events, with Israel and pro-Palestinian groups clashing over what messaging appears acceptable at international matches.
dek: The football club’s president said UEFA had made them aware of a complaint by Israel regarding pro-Palestinian banners.
title: Galatasaray defies Israel complaint over Palestine banners
